xlg14_run_stuff_nfl_run_stuff_net_oe_bri.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign (the coefficient's interval is not wholly negative), split-half reliability of the trait not measured, and no positive control bounds an effect this small: the NFL add-one harness shows about .26 logit per SD four times in five (docs/lanes/xlg-harness-power-2026-11-14.md).
xlg14_run_stuff_nfl_run_stuff_net_oe_bri.description: NFL confirmation of the college-first survivor run_stuff_net_oe: designed runs (play_type run, not a dropback or kneel) gaining zero or fewer yards, centred on the league rate of each game's own week, per run over earlier weeks of the season, residualised on own ATS margin to date; home minus away; one offset-logistic coefficient per SD on the served out-of-season probability, opener grade 2020-2025, leave-one-season-out. Nonzero games 1415; changed picks 58, record 17-41; coefficient per SD -0.0162 [-0.1151, +0.0876], positive in 1 of 6 folds (expected positive, the college sign); this metric sits at percentile 38.5 of 200 within-season shuffles of the same column; in-sample minus held-out +0.000292.
xlg14_run_stuff_nfl_run_stuff_net_oe_bri.notes: Family xlg14_run_stuff_family_u10: one of the three pre-declared NFL confirmations of the college survivors; 3 gating reads (log-loss percentile in the matched null with the full-sample coefficient sign), 3 recorded cells each; terms declared in the lane before any outcome was joined; outcome: opposite sign. Not served.
